title: Lord of the Flies
author: William Golding
summary: A group of British schoolboys is stranded on an uninhabited island after a plane crash. Without adults, they try to organise themselves, and the effort turns into rivalry and fear.
readIf: you like short, chilling parables about how fast order can fall apart.
skipIf: you want hope or tenderness; it is a bleak story about children hurting each other.

pairings.reason: Also puts young people in a lethal contest, with a stronger sense of heroism and a bigger plot.
Another stark, short novel about humanity pushed to its limit, with a quieter and more tender centre.
A much gentler survival story about a boy alone, showing nature as a challenge instead of a mirror for evil.
